sources.title: CDP Climate and Water Security Response
facts: The response lists VCS project 2372 serial ranges among credits retired in Q1 2024 on behalf of Boeing.
Boeing says the retirements were used toward its Scope 1 and Scope 2 net-zero target, with offsets beyond that target applied to 2023 business-travel emissions.
The response states no adjustments had been issued for those credits as of its 7/2024 reporting date.

sources.title: Verra Cancels 5 Million Overissued Credits Linked to C-Quest Capital
facts: Verra completed QCRs for 22 C-Quest cookstove projects.
Across the completed reviews, Verra determined that 5,004,915 VCUs had been issued in excess and processed cancellation of 5,004,915 VCUs.
For project 2372, Verra reported 4,444,642 VCUs issued, 2,409,500 revised emission reductions, and 2,035,142 VCUs compensated.

sources.title: FAQs for Quality Control Reviews
facts: Credits issued before a QCR that were transferred/sold to another holder, retired, or canceled are not changed in registry status by the QCR and remain valid in the Verra Registry.
If a QCR finds excess issuance, Verra requires replacement/compensation by the responsible project proponent or authorized representative in applicable circumstances.
If all excess credits are replaced, Verra says the environmental integrity of all issuances to the project is considered restored.
Verra encourages holders to consider the ramifications of a QCR in light of relevant corporate reporting standards and best practice.
